big_case.notes: High-stakes Solicitor General petition presenting a major First Amendment question—whether viewpoint-discrimination limits under Rosenberger bar executive-branch termination of competitive federal research grants under Finley and Rust—implicating roughly $200 billion in annual federal grantmaking and dozens of pending suits nationwide. Tempered at this stage by its interlocutory preliminary-injunction posture limited to UC researchers across two agencies (NSF and NEH), active parallel permanent-injunction appeals in the Second Circuit, and the Court's unadorned first-conference cert denial leaving the broader constitutional issue for a later vehicle.
